title: Reverse Words in a String
statement:
Given a string `s`, return the words of `s` in reverse order, separated by a single space.

A word is a run of characters that are not spaces. `s` may have leading or trailing spaces and several spaces between two words; the result must not.
constraints: s contains at least one word
s consists of English letters, digits and spaces

keyPoints.text: Splits on runs of spaces so leading, trailing and repeated spaces produce no empty words
Joins the words in reverse order with exactly one space
Builds the result in linear time (a string builder or join, not repeated concatenation)

tests.name: Example 2
tests.explanation: Leading and trailing spaces are dropped.
